objective: Make the private-artifact bar checkable somewhere other than one machine's untracked bytes. Today it resolves paths under internal-docs/prompts/, which .gitignore line 128 excludes wholesale (/internal-docs/prompts/). The files exist in the author's working copy and nowhere else, so the gate reports PASS there and FAIL in every detached worktree and every CI run.
falsifiable_claim: check-work-item-contract produces the same verdict detached at a commit as it does in a working copy, because every path it resolves is either tracked or declared unresolvable-by-design.
in_scope: The private-artifact path resolution in check-work-item-contract, and the records whose declared artifacts sit under a gitignored prefix.
out_of_scope: Any change to .gitignore line 128; the prompts tree is private by intent and this record does not propose publishing it.
The QM dormant-adoption cut, which merely FOUND this and does not own it.
positive_proof: Run check-work-item-contract detached at master's tip in a fresh worktree; verdict matches the working-copy run.
Every private artifact path a record declares is either tracked, or carries an explicit declaration that it is intentionally private and therefore not path-checked.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: MEASURED, NOT PREDICTED. master detached at a fresh worktree: check-work-item-contract FAIL (5 error, 1 warn, 0 skip), all five 'private artifact path does not resolve' under internal-docs/prompts/. The same commit in the working copy passes. git check-ignore reports .gitignore:128:/internal-docs/prompts/ for each.

A gate whose verdict depends on untracked bytes is the invisible-evidence class at the gate layer: it vouches for something no reviewer, no other machine, and no CI run can see. The failure mode is not the FAIL detached -- it is the PASS in the working copy, which is the one nobody investigates.

Do not close this by deleting the paths from the records. The reference is real and worth keeping; what is missing is a declaration that the artifact is private, so the bar can distinguish 'intentionally unreachable' from 'broken link'.
remaining_nonclaims: Whether the referenced prompt-run artifacts should become tracked, or stay private with a declaration, is the owner's call and is not decided here.
This record does not claim the five failing paths are the only instances; it claims the MECHANISM is general to any path under a gitignored prefix.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Withdraw on loss of selected live adapter evidence.
